svg.title: iAP2 Tab5 — cursor and focus operating diagram
svg.desc: Six actual simulator screens annotated with active focus, movement, Enter, Back, Up Next, modal context menu, and clock editing behavior. Orange marks the active cursor; dashed gray marks inactive content; teal marks touch controls.

g.text: iAP2 Tab5 / Actual UI screens with focus paths and button actions
Open or activate the selected item
The UI’s own focus is the gray row + left bar.
Example: Albums · the left list owns the knob
Enter transfers focus to the detail
The same album stays selected; its tracks now own the knob
Moves the highlighted album; preview follows.
Opens that album and enters its detail panel.
Stops at the first / last row; focus stays visible.
Artists, Playlists and Settings use two panels.
Play All is focused. Down reaches track 1 (shown).
Shuffle ↔ Play All ↔ tracks, in that order.
Plays the focused track or activates the control.
Restores the selected album in the left list.
This screen has no knob focus until Up Next is opened
The first upcoming song is selected when the list appears
No selection moves while Up Next is hidden.
Opens Up Next; press again to hide it.
Play / pause works without moving focus.
Moves only through upcoming queue rows.
Jumps playback to that song; queue refreshes.
Closes Up Next and returns to the full player.
Moves focus to the first upcoming row.
From Now Playing: hold Enter for 650 ms, or press C
A field keeps focus while the knob changes its value
Moves between menu actions; headings are skipped.
Closes the menu; underlying focus is preserved.
6 and tab keys are ignored; media keys still work.
Enter Clock; Up/Down selects a date or time field.
Enter starts editing. Up increases; Down decreases.
Ends editing; changes already apply immediately.
Returns focus to Clock in the Settings list.
Navigation rules you can rely on
Detail → remembered list row → first list item → Now Playing
1–5: Now Playing / Albums / Artists / Songs / Playlists. [ / ]: previous / next tab, including Settings.
Returning to a library tab focuses its left list at the remembered row. Press that tab again to leave detail, then go to the top.
Tap a row to select / activate it. Preview controls can work without taking knob focus. Swipe scrolls; disabled touch is ignored.
The focus bar is your next action target. A play icon marks the track that is already playing.
Current implementation · app/ui/ui.c + sim/main.c · Gray theme · Mock library · Orange / teal / dashed boxes are diagram annotations
